g.title: seq
g.text: 15a Government corporations (GOCCs): corporate operating budget, budgetary support and reports

a.text: 1. GOCC management to GOCC board: Proposed COB
2. GOCC board to GOCC management: Board
approval
3. GOCC management to DBM: COB on or before 31
March, with DBM Forms 700, 703-A to 703-C,
4. DBM: Evaluate: uses agree with the board
approval, sources cover uses, national
priorities, physical performance, use of last
year's budget, financial ratios
5. DBM to GOCC management: COB approval letter
(within 20 working days)
6. GOCC management to DBM: Request for subsidy
or equity in the national budget proposal
7. Congress to DBM: GAA item "Budgetary
Support to Government Corporations"
8. GOCC management to DBM: Special Budget
Request. The amount must be in the board-
approved COB
9. DBM to BTr: Release document
10. BTr to GOCC management: Cash released
directly to the corporation

a.xlink:title: skip: The corporation owes the Treasury

a.text: 11. BTr: Offset the release against dividends
due, guarantee fees, advances and other
receivables
12. GOCC management to BTr: Dividends: at
least 50 percent of annual net earnings

a.xlink:title: end of: The corporation owes the Treasury

a.text: 13. GOCC management to DBM: Quarterly
financial and physical reports through URS,
within 30 days after each quarter. Also
published on its website
14. GOCC management to Congress: Written
notice that the reports were submitted and
published
15. GOCC management to COA: Year-end financial
statements by 14 February
16. COA to GOCC board: Audit report
17. GCG to GOCC board: Performance targets and
evaluation of the corporation
